summary.text: Carey Coleman is the Republican nominee in Ohio's 13th Congressional District and a Northeast Ohio broadcaster. According to his campaign website, he has been a longtime radio host on WNIR and a television meteorologist, and he is running on fiscal discipline, secure borders and support for law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, he is a longtime Northeast Ohio radio host and community leader, known for commentary on WNIR.
According to his campaign website, he served for decades as a television meteorologist on national, statewide and local Northeast Ohio outlets.
Won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for Ohio's 13th District with 47.3% of the vote, ahead of Kevin Siembida, Margaret Briem, Neil Patel and Sanjin Drakovac.
His campaign website says he lives in Northeast Ohio and is involved in local civic life and charitable causes; his campaign committee lists a Macedonia, Ohio, address.
